name: EXP-C1 · Day 0 · Empty-room baseline (per zone)
description: Thirty minutes of empty hall per zone. This is what every later take is measured against.

config.description:
The noise floor, the structural-variance fit and the trigger calibration all read this block. One warning from the probe: never calibrate the drift trigger on empty-room data alone — all four missed splice detections shared an empty-room-calibrated source.

The phone does not illuminate — it marks block boundaries and carries the truth channel. Illumination is monad01 injecting on 2.4 GHz ch11.
Thirty minutes, nobody inside the marked zone. Leave the phone in the zone, screen off, and stand outside it.
Repeat per zone before any staged block.
